paragraph: In October 2026 INFOSI, the state's information-society agency, [certified and approved the AngolaID platform for use nationwide](<https://pti.ao/infosi-certifica-e-aprova-utilizacao-da-plataforma-angolaid/>). Justice Minister Marcy Lopes says [the Interior Ministry, prisons and the migration service check the ID database](<https://angop.ao/noticias/politica/cerca-de-16-milhoes-de-cidadaos-constam-da-base-do-bilhete-de-identidade/>) when issuing passports. In the last twelve months, a presidential order of 13 August 2026 [authorised USD 28 million for a national digital identity and e-signature platform](<https://valoreconomico.co.ao/artigo/pr-autoriza-mais-70-milhoes-de-dolares-para-a-transformacao-digital-do-pais>). No source found shows one authentication service used across several services or channels. Operating would need authentication used across services or channels.

The Bank of the Republic of Burundi told ID4Africa in 2025 that it [signed a contract in November 2024 for a biometric financial ID](<https://www.id4africa.com/2025/files/T3-P3-S2-5-Burundi_FINAL.pdf>), meant to let banks and mobile money operators verify customers. In the last twelve months, on 17 November 2026, the ICT secretariat [issued a World Bank-funded call for proposals for a national public key infrastructure](<https://projects.banquemondiale.org/fr/projects-operations/procurement-detail/OP00482177>). SIM registration from June 2026 [requires the national identity card](<https://www.agenceecofin.com/actualites-numerique/0506-139050-burundi-identification-des-cartes-sim-obligatoire-avant-le-25-juin>), presented in person. Nothing has been found saying the central bank's ID is in use. Establishing would need one state-accepted authentication service in use.

The identification agency ANIP [reported 27 million identity verification requests in 2025](<https://id4africa.com/2026/files/T4-1-S2-3-Benin-FINAL.pdf>). The 2026 playbook says [getting a phone number and using public service platforms both depend on NPI authentication](<https://id4africa.com/2026/files/T1-2-2-Benin-FINAL.pdf>). In the last twelve months, from 15 October 2026, the pension fund's Preuve de Vie app [checks retirees by fingerprint against their NPI](<https://www.ecofinagency.com/news-digital/1710-59862-benin-launches-app-letting-public-sector-retirees-provide-proof-of-life-remotely>), which serves one procedure. No source found since October 2023 says a mobile ID, ID wallet or signed credential is in service. Mature would need a state-accepted mobile ID app, ID wallet or signed credentials in service.

On 15 September 2026 the Prime Minister [launched FasoSign](<https://cfinance.news/article/burkina-fasomodernisation-de-ladministration-publique-le-premier-ministre-lance-la-plateforme-fasosign-pour-boucler-la-boucle-de-la-dematerialisation/>), the national e-signature platform. ANSSI's director general said it is already operational on three government systems: SIGED, CIMEXT and SYC@D. In the last twelve months this launch is the one change found. In April 2025 the public key infrastructure platform had been installed and [about thirty staff trained](<https://prod.cybastiontech.com/blog/newsroom-4/cybastion-trains-the-it-teams-of-the-government-of-burkina-faso-in-the-electronic-signature-system-348>). No source found since October 2023 says a mobile ID, ID wallet or signed credential is in service. Mature would need a state-accepted mobile ID app, ID wallet or signed credentials in service.

In September 2026 Business Tech Africa [reported that the Bankers' Association of Botswana had launched a national eKYC project](<https://www.businesstechafrica.co.za/article/botswana-launches-national-ekyc-project-to-make-bank-verification-easier>) that lets banks verify customer identities against the national citizen database. A P423 million public key infrastructure was funded, and [the Permanent Secretary told the Public Accounts Committee it remains incomplete and not in operation](<https://weekendpost.co.bw/p420-million-digital-bombshell/>). A [September 2015 World Bank diagnostic](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/864651486101539760/pdf/Botswana-ID4D-DiagnosticWeb040418.pdf>) said the national identity system was linked to the electoral system, social benefits, payroll and transport. The eKYC project is the one change found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says authentication is used across services or channels. Operating would need authentication used across services or channels.

ANSSI announced on 24 July 2026 that the [national public key infrastructure is in service](<https://www.anssi.ci/>). The DMOA says it is [extending electronic signature across public administration](<https://techafricanews.com/2026/09/18/cote-divoire-expands-electronic-signature-paperless-administration/>). In the last twelve months, a [feasibility study for a national authentication platform and digital identity wallet](<https://startupmedias.africa/articles/cote-ivoire-plateforme-nationale-authentification-identite-numerique>) began in October 2026. In November 2026 ANSSI said [the root PKI serves public bodies only](<https://digitalmag.ci/signature-electronique-et-pki-racine-lanssi-pose-les-bases-de-la-confiance-numerique-en-cote-divoire/>). The Côte d'Ivoire Identité app says the authorities do not yet recognise its digital identity. Mature would need a state-accepted mobile ID app, ID wallet or signed credentials in service.

In October 2026 summit figures put [secure electronic signature live on the AIGLE platform in 37 of the 40 administrations](<https://leconomie.info/article/digitalisation-e-gov-africa-mise-sur-lia-pour-moderniser-les-services-publics>). Users of the COLEPS e-procurement platform [acquire an electronic certificate to authenticate themselves](<https://theguardianpostcameroon.com/post/4439/en/homesensitise-train-stakeholders-on-e-procurement-system-home>), and the procurement ministry trained them from 10 October 2024. A [decree of February 2025](<https://www.prc.cm/files/7f/4b/5b/2ce7f303c8e3bd44fa83c05acf9ddbf9.pdf>) put the national ID production centre in charge of the certificates its public key infrastructure issues. The AIGLE figures are the one change found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says a mobile ID, ID wallet or signed credential is in service. Mature would need a state-accepted mobile ID app, ID wallet or signed credentials in service.

[RDC-PASS, a digital identifier to authenticate Congolese for digital services, was activated on 13 June 2026](<https://oeildafrique.com/2026/09/17/rdc-pass-identite-numerique/>) under a 20-year public-private partnership. In the last twelve months, [the minister said in September 2026 that it had entered a first operational phase, with 50 enrolment agents trained](<https://www.agenceecofin.com/actualites-numerique/3009-142019-rdc-strategies-identite-numerique-et-cybersecurite-au-bilan-d-un-an-de-reformes>). In October 2026 [another order named the heads of the electronic certification authority, ANCE](<https://numerico.cd/fr/article/rdc-serge-kaozi-lubamba-nomme-a-la-tete-des-missions-de-l-ance>). No source found since October 2023 says an authentication service is in use. Establishing would need one state-accepted authentication service in use.

[In October 2025 the coordinator of the NIU project said his team was building a platform to check NIU numbers online](<https://www.finances.gouv.cg/en/node/4803>), to tell real numbers from false ones. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says authentication is used across services or channels, and no verification service used by several bodies has been reported. No app lets people prove who they are online with the NIU. No source found says the online NIU check is in service. Establishing would need a state-accepted authentication service in use for one purpose, such as an online check of the ID for one system.

No stage is set. Nothing has been found since October 2023 that names a digital authentication service in Comoros. No state-accepted authentication, e-signature or PKI service has been found that is authorised, contracted or piloted. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Absent would need a source from the past three years that says no digital authentication service exists and credentials are checked by eye.

By January 2026 the national identity system, SNIAC, [had issued about 1,291,910 digital certificates](<https://imij.gov.cv/noticias/cms-noticia-24>) for authentication and qualified signature, the justice IT institute IMIJ says. The state platform Autentika [gives single sign-on across public and private applications](<https://portal-autentika.gov.cv/en/autentika>). Holders of the ID card can [obtain the Mobile Digital Key online](<https://portal-autentika.gov.cv/en/cabo-verde-mobile-digital-key>), created by a legislative decree in 2020. In the last twelve months, SNIAC [published version 1.9.9 of its card middleware](<https://sniac.cv/mw/>) in March 2026. In July 2026 Caboverde24 reported [the ID.GOV.CV digital ID wallet](<https://caboverde24.info/en/2026/07/22/ja-sabe-como-aceder-aos-servicos-publicos-sem-sair-de-casa-analisamos-o-site/>). The latest dated fact found is that July 2026 report.

The Interior Ministry says [Mobile ID, launched officially on 10 February 2026](<https://interieur.gouv.dj/forum-sur-lidentite-numerique-et-lancement-du-projet-mobile-id/>), lets citizens authenticate electronically to reach public services and do procedures remotely. It adds that partner administrations use its authentication services, without direct access to the databases. In the last twelve months this launch is the one change found. The director general says the directorate is [working on an interoperability system](<https://www.lanation.dj/notre-vision-est-de-faire-de-la-direction-generale-de-la-population-et-de-la-famille-une-administration-entierement-modernisee-interconnectee-et-proche-des-citoyens-abdi-abdillahi-obsie/>) meant to let administrations, banks and social protection bodies verify a national ID card in real time. The latest dated fact found is the launch of 10 February 2026.

In May 2026 the Interior Ministry said [the biometric ID card carries an electronic authentication certificate](<https://id4africa.com/2026/files/T2-3-S3-4-Algeria-FINAL.pdf>), backed by a public key infrastructure. In July 2026 the High Commission for Digitalisation said [the national portal's first 21 services are reached through the digital identity](<https://lesenjeuxeco.dz/lancement-du-portail-national-des-services-numeriques-la-e-gouvernance-en-marche/>). In the last twelve months, from August 2026, [the Sports Ministry's WADHIFATI platform accepts it](<https://www.horizons.dz/2026/08/les-plateformes-du-ministere-des-sports-integrees-dans-lecosysteme-national-des-services-numeriques/>) without a separate account. In April 2024 the Interior Ministry [planned a digital identity reached from phones](<https://www.algerie360.com/lancement-des-identites-numeriques-des-citoyens-avant-fin-2024/>) by the end of that year. No source found since October 2023 says a mobile ID app or ID wallet is in service. Mature would need a state-accepted mobile ID app, ID wallet or signed credentials in service.

On 7 November 2026 the justice and communications ministries [launched a remote power of attorney service](<https://www.vetogate.com/5767586>). Citizens prove who they are in the digital identity app by a face scan matched to state biometric records. In the last twelve months, the Interior Ministry [announced a pilot of MOIEG-PASS in March 2026](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202603/egypt-pilots-selfie-biometrics-to-streamline-access-to-digital-govt-services>), where users scan their national ID and face to sign in. Since July 2026 the Public Prosecution's criminal-judgment enquiry service has [checked enquirers through the Digital Egypt identity](<https://gate.ahram.org.eg/News/5838334.aspx>). No source found gives how many people use the digital identity app. The latest dated fact found is the 7 November 2026 launch.

[In April 2026 Dashen Bank let customers open accounts remotely with Fayda credentials](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202604/dashen-bank-launches-ethiopias-first-digital-id-based-accounts>). [By August 2026, 150 enterprises had integrated Fayda for biometric KYC checks](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202608/faydaverse-officially-enters-africas-dpi-market>). In the last twelve months, [in December 2025 the central bank told all banks to open new accounts through the VeriFayda 2 eKYC system](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202512/ethiopia-banks-harmonize-customer-account-information-with-fayda-digital-id>). [In November 2026 FaydaVerse said citizens use the FaydaPass wallet free of charge with their Fayda ID, and that nine government institutions have joined it](<https://capitalethiopia.com/2026/11/22/faydapass-seeks-to-bring-government-documents-into-digital-wallet/>). No figure has been found for how many people use the Fayda Wallet. The latest dated fact found is that November 2026 statement.

In September 2026 [the Gabon Digital programme, World Bank financed and run by the digital economy ministry](<https://www.gabonreview.com/etat-civil-des-experts-reunis-a-ntoum-pour-preparer-la-reforme-numerique/>), included a national digital identity system for access to public services. [Gabonreview reports that on 28 April 2026 the DGI, CNSS and CNAMGS launched work on the Declaration unique des salaires](<https://www.gabonreview.com/dus-un-tournant-numerique-pour-la-transparence-salariale-au-gabon/>), with operation targeted for July 2026. [GabonReview says the SNID will give every resident a digital identity](<https://www.gabonreview.com/identite-digitale-le-gabon-franchit-un-cap-vers-une-gouvernance-inclusive-et-securisee/>) with the same legal value as physical identity. All three items come from the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says an authentication service is in use. Establishing would need one state-accepted authentication service in use.

On 7 October 2024 the Vice President [launched the CitizenApp (CADIS)](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202410/ghana-launches-citizenapp-to-facilitate-access-to-digital-govt-services>). People scan their Ghana Card to create a digital ID, with biometric single sign-on to services. [About 284 institutions used the NIA verification platform by August 2026](<https://today.com.gh/muntaka-nia-clears-ghana-card-backlog-registers-418000-children/>), the interior minister said, against [191 in February 2024](<https://www.ghanaweb.com/GhanaHomePage/NewsArchive/191-financial-institutions-now-have-seamless-access-to-National-Identification-Authority-Data-1914728>). In the last twelve months, the NIA said in September 2026 that a [Ghana Card e-wallet would be activated in phases](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202609/ghana-card-digital-wallet-to-facilitate-bank-transfers-mobile-money-payments>). Nothing found after October 2024 says the CitizenApp is still in use. The latest dated fact found is the September 2026 statement on the e-wallet.

[On 22 January 2026 the DGE and ONECI signed a convention](<https://mediaguinee.com/2026/01/conakry-la-dge-et-loneci-scellent-une-alliance-pour-un-fichier-electoral-fiable/>) under which the national register is the sole source of voter identification data. [The digital agency ANDE is developing a public key infrastructure to secure electronic signatures](<https://guineenews.org/2026/10/21/signature-electronique-de-letat-la-guinee-accelere-sa-marche-vers-le-zero-papier-et-la-souverainete-numerique/>). Nine draft texts on its use were under review on 21 October 2026. In the last twelve months, [a November 2026 workshop drew up a roadmap](<https://mediaguinee.com/2026/11/confiance-numerique-en-guinee-apres-quatre-jours-de-travaux-une-feuille-de-route-elaboree-pour-loperationnalisation-de-la-signature-electronique/>) that recommends a pilot. It targets public-sector e-signature from early 2027. No source found since October 2023 says an authentication or e-signature service is in use. Establishing would need one state-accepted authentication service in use.

[The government says the National Identity Management System, launched 30 June 2026](<https://foroyaa.net/gambians-welcome-biometric-id-rollout/>), combines a national identity register with biometric technology and real-time verification. A 2025 World Bank diagnostic says [the Drivers License System uses the National ID system for biometric verification of applicants](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099102025103014657/pdf/P502279-e8627dee-4568-45e7-bb51-9a1aea1ff040.pdf>), to prevent identity fraud and duplication. The same diagnostic says the national ID's NIN was populated into the eCRVS to cross-verify parents' IDs. The June 2026 launch is the one change found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says authentication is used across services or channels. Operating would need authentication used across services or channels.

In June 2026 [the IPRS Secretary said over 800 organisations are integrated for citizen verification](<https://www.kenyanews.go.ke/govt-enhances-registration-of-persons-through-new-technology/>), among them banks, insurers, SACCOs, telecoms and employment agencies. That figure is the one change found in the last twelve months. [The government has piloted the Maisha Digital ID, a virtual ID for smartphone users, since November 2023](<https://www.kenyanews.go.ke/state-revs-up-maisha-namba-digital-id-awareness-drive/>). In October 2025 the Communications Authority [required every critical information infrastructure system to use digital certificates only from the certification service providers it licenses](<https://eastleighvoice.co.ke/technology/222141/ca-orders-telecom-operators-to-adopt-licensed-digital-certification-services-or-face-penalties>). No source found since October 2023 says a mobile ID, ID wallet or signed credential is in service. Mature would need a state-accepted mobile ID app, ID wallet or signed credentials in service.

The National Identification Registry says an [MoU with the Civil Service Agency in May 2024](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202503/liberia-says-national-id-system-drives-digital-economy-facilitates-service-delivery>) allows national ID numbers to be used for payroll verification. It also says an October 2024 MoU with the Liberia Telecommunications Authority makes the national ID a requirement for SIM registration. In the last twelve months, [a concession with OeSD International for digital identity credentials and authentication awaited ratification by the legislature in September 2026](<https://allafrica.com/stories/202609080549.html>). It is not yet in force. No source found since October 2023 says authentication is used across services or channels. Operating would need authentication used across services or channels.

[In April 2026 the General Information Authority and the Central Bank of Libya reviewed a link for eKYC](<https://www.gia.gov.ly/en/2026/04/19/general-information-authority-central-bank-of-libya-national-authority-for-combating-money-laundering-with-the-relevant-authorities/>) that would connect the Level 3 biometric digital identity to banking systems. Technical trials with the Central Bank and a number of banks had begun, ahead of launch and integration. In February 2025 [an NESDB summary proposed a digital ID wallet for each citizen](<https://nesdb.ly/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%87%D9%88%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B1%D9%82%D9%85%D9%8A%D8%A9.pdf>). The April 2026 review is the one change found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says an authentication service is in use. Establishing would need one state-accepted authentication service in use.

In June 2026 FinMark Trust [listed Lesotho's digital identity cards among domestic eKYC frameworks](<https://finmark.org.za/knowledge-hub/blog/building-a-cross-border-dpi-for-financial-inclusion-in-sadc>) with uses in financial services. In the last twelve months, [the finance ministry sought bids in June 2026 for a recovery site for the identity systems](<https://projects.worldbank.org/en/projects-operations/procurement-detail/OP00452505>), including a hardware security module for PKI. The 2026 MICSTI-UNICEF work plan [continues building MOSIP-based identity infrastructure](<https://www.gov.ls/government/micsti-and-unicef-signed-digital-id-work-plan/>) aimed at secure authentication across government and private services. No source found since October 2023 says authentication is used across services or channels. Operating would need authentication used across services or channels.

The digital transition ministry says [more than 34 institutions use the digital identity service](<https://al3omk.com/1166931.html>), with about 100 others preparing to join. The DGSN's 2026 playbook says [the platform serves 73 services and 54 partners](<https://id4africa.com/2026/files/T1-1-4-Morocco-FINAL.pdf>). An Interior Ministry deck of 2026 [counts over 70 million authentications by the population register](<https://connect.mosip.io/resources_pdf_2026/Collaborations_between_Governments_and_Academic_Institutions.pdf>). In the last twelve months, in June 2026, [DGSN officials said Mon e-ID is already in use](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202606/morocco-moves-national-id-renewal-online-as-digital-identity-modernization-advances>), letting citizens carry a digital version of their ID card. The latest dated fact found is that June 2026 statement.

[The government told the World Bank's GovTech survey in 2025 that a digital signature regulation and a public key infrastructure are in place](<https://datacatalog.worldbank.org/search/dataset/0037889/govtech-dataset>), and that they are not yet used. The answer names no service built on them and no date for their launch. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source has been found showing a digital way for people to prove who they are online, or a public service that accepts a digital signature or a login. Establishing would need one state-accepted authentication service in use.

In June 2025 [DPI Map recorded that NINA, Mali's national ID number, had no digital authentication function](<https://dpimap.org/mali/>). In December 2023 the head of the electronic signature service said [it had not officially started](<https://www.maliweb.net/technologie/certification-et-signature-electronique-la-4eme-session-ordinaire-du-comite-fait-letat-des-lieux-3045750.html>). In the last twelve months, in August 2026, [participants in the Semaine du Numerique validated the rollout of the first public services based on electronic signature](<https://www.maliweb.net/technologie/semaine-du-numerique-2026-le-mali-adopte-une-feuille-de-route-ambitieuse-pour-accelerer-sa-transformation-digitale-3118856.html>). No source found says any such service is in use. None says the online criminal-record and nationality platforms of [10 February 2026](<https://www.maliweb.net/societe/le-ministere-de-la-justice-a-lere-du-numerique-voici-le-casier-et-la-nationalite-en-ligne-3113977.html>) check the NINA against the register. Establishing would need an authentication service in use for one purpose, such as a certification authority operating.

Mozambique's Digital Certification System (SCDM), launched in 2023, lets [accredited users sign and verify electronic documents free of charge](<https://intic.gov.mz/sistema-de-certificacao-digital-mocambique-registou-crescimento-na-adesao-de-assinaturas-electronicas-em-2024/>). INTIC said more than ten public institutions used it by the end of 2024. In the last twelve months, [Decree 40/2026, reported in August 2026, lets acts in the low-risk business procedure be validated by electronic signature](<https://executivedigest.sapo.pt/atividades-economicas-de-baixo-risco-em-mocambique-com-certidao-em-duas-horas-e-assinatura-digital/>). [The ATDI tendered a national mobile digital ID and signature infrastructure in May 2026](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202605/mozambique-seeks-partner-for-mobile-digital-id-e-signature-rollout>). No mobile ID or digital ID wallet is in service. Mature would need a state-accepted mobile ID app, ID wallet or signed credentials in service.

[The Houwiyeti digital ID and digital-government platform, launched in 2023, handles 70 percent of passport requests](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202505/african-nations-making-digital-id-gains-in-the-face-of-common-challenges>), the ANRPTS director said in 2025. [Tech Rek states Houwiyeti is the gateway public and private services use to verify citizens' identity](<https://techrek.info/fr/houwiyeti-de-nouveau-operationnelle-de-la-maintenance-periodique-a-la-question-de-la-souverainete-numerique/>). [TECH5 says a digital ID is created from a passport or ID card and stored on the holder's phone](<https://tech5.ai/mauritania-digital-id-undp-funding/>). It is verified by selfie to log in to the e-government portal. In the last twelve months, in August 2026, an op-ed said Houwiyeti [issues signed digital birth, marriage, divorce and death documents that can be checked by QR code](<https://www.elmourageb.com/node/25951>). The latest dated fact found is that August 2026 op-ed.

[Since 29 September 2026 about 884,000 licence holders can view a digital driving licence on the KOREK! app](<https://lexpress.mu/node/563226>), L'Express reports, and MauPass handles identification and authentication. [The 2024 regulations provide for the MauSign Certification Authority](<https://paps.mnis.govmu.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/29_The-National-IC-Reg-2024-.pdf>), which issues certificates stored on the ID card and one-time certificates for MauPass users to sign on the mobile ID. [Biometric Update says Mauritius launched a mobile digital ID system in 2024](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202605/theres-no-digital-id-without-data-protection-mauritius-privacy-chief>). In the last twelve months the KOREK! launch is the one change found. The latest dated fact found is the launch of 29 September 2026.

[The Nzika Digital ID Wallet was launched in Lilongwe on 16 September 2026](<https://www.undp.org/malawi/news/malawi-launches-nzika-digital-id-wallet-and-removes-expiry-date-national-id>), and [more than 22,000 people had signed up by launch day](<https://malawi24.com/2026/11/09/malawis-nzika-digital-id-bounced-at-the-bank/>). The Homeland Security Minister said it [lets citizens present verified credentials and reach services before their physical card arrives](<https://mwnation.com/national-ids-to-last-a-lifetime/>). The 2026 NRB fee regulations [charge for e-KYC checks of mobile money, SIM, bank and utility customers](<https://malawi24.com/2026/08/17/nrb-hikes-registration-fees/>). In the last twelve months, by November 2026, some banks refused the wallet, and the bankers' association said it was piloted with one bank. The latest dated fact found is that November 2026 report.

[The Home Affairs minister, Lucia Iipumbu, said Namibia launched its national public key infrastructure under DigiNam in August 2026](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202610/namibia-mps-press-government-on-security-access-and-reach-of-planned-digital-id>). [In November 2026 the ICT ministry told a financial-sector advisory body it was ready to launch a PKI for legally recognised e-signatures](<https://techreviewafrica.com/news/8326/namibia-highlights-digital-public-infrastructure-progress-in-financial-sector-transformation>). In the last twelve months the sources disagree. In November 2025 CRAN said [the infrastructure was ready for the PKI rollout](<https://thebrief.com.na/2025/11/namibia-moves-closer-to-secure-digital-identity-and-online-verification-system/>). In July 2026 an OPM director said [electronic identity checks had saved about N$16 million on social grants](<https://informante.web.na/?p=398234>). No source found since October 2023 says authentication is used across services or channels. Operating would need authentication used across services or channels.

[In July 2026 the WURI Niger project said it was developing a National Population Register to identify and authenticate people seeking services](<https://www.lesahel.org/wuri-niger-restructure-une-opportunite-pour-une-identification-universelle-de-la-population-au-service-de-linclusion-et-du-un-puissant-facteur-de-developpement-inclusif-et-une-dimension/>), with a first enrolment phase in Niamey's five arrondissements due within weeks. [Niger signed an MoU on 27 June 2025 with Libyan firm Al Itissal Al Jadeed for a new electronic national ID card](<https://www.wearetech.africa/en/fils-uk/news/tech/niger-moves-to-modernize-id-system-with-biometric-e-id-and-e-passport>) aimed at online authentication. [NIMC's director general says NINAuth processes over 1.3 million identity checks a day](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202608/digital-id-assessments-highlight-financial-inclusion-gains-across-africa>) for banks, fintechs and government agencies. [About 63 government agencies had integrated with NIMC's verification API by October 2026](<https://techcabal.com/2026/10/14/nimc-identity-database-locally-hosted/>). [NIMC says individuals can use NINAuth to verify their identity for SIM registration, immigration and passports, tax filing and financial transactions](<https://nigeriacommunicationsweek.com.ng/2026/09/23/nimc-unveils-consent-based-nin-verification-to-authenticate-identity>), with their consent required. In the last twelve months, [the NIMC Act 2026 made NIMC the national root certification authority](<https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/09/16/fg-sets-december-deadline-for-95-nin-coverage/>). No figure has been found for how many people hold or use the NINAuth app. The latest dated fact found is the October 2026 agency count.

A national ID deck of May 2026 says [IN Groupe was procured to supply authentication and a PKI for digital signatures](<https://id4africa.com/2026/files/T1-3-1-Rwanda-FINAL.pdf>). In August 2026 Vital Strategies said [digital birth registration linked to the national ID allows real-time identity checks across sectors](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202608/birth-registration-emerges-as-foundation-for-digital-public-infrastructure>), and that the system supports access to around 200 essential services. The New Times [reported that digital IDs were expected in July 2027](<https://www.newtimes.co.rw/article/38236/news/rwanda/enrollment-for-digital-id-surpasses-8-million---nida>). [The Cybersecurity Authority calls SUDAPASS the national digital identity platform](<https://sca.gov.sd/en/sudapass>) and says it verifies identity by biometrics, a PIN code and a QR code. [The Sudanese Digital Identity smartphone app lets a user hold an account and sign electronic transactions](<https://sudapass.gov.sd/terms?lang=en>). The transactions are binding and count as evidence in court. [The digital ministry and the Central Bank are linking the remaining banks one by one](<https://www.suna.sd/posts/bnk-am-drman-alotny-aol-bnk-ytyh-thdyth-byanat-alaamlaaa-rkmya-bastkhdam-sodabas>), SUNA reports. In the last twelve months, [the Baldna platform let users sign in with the SudaPass digital ID](<https://baldna.gov.sd/>), as its login page showed in November 2026. The latest dated fact found is that November 2026 login page.

[The e-Sénégal app, launched on 24 March 2026, signs users in on the NIN of the biometric ID card](<https://www.ndarinfo.com/Comment-obtenir-ses-documents-administratifs-en-ligne-avec-la-nouvelle-appli-e-Senegal_a43744.html>), and judicial records and nationality certificates were among its first procedures. [ARCOP says the APPEL e-procurement platform, opened on 14 October 2025, uses strong authentication and e-signature](<https://arcop.sn/2025/10/17/appel-le-clic-de-la-transparence-le-senegal-entre-dans-lere-numerique-de-la-commande-publique/>). In the last twelve months, [IPRES opened its proof-of-life campaign for pensioners on 1 July 2026 on the Maa ngi nii platform](<https://aps.sn/lipres-annonce-le-debut-de-la-campagne-periodique-de-collecte-de-preuve-de-vie-ce-mercredi/>), which needs the ECOWAS national ID card. No source found since October 2023 says authentication is used across services or channels. Operating would need authentication used across services or channels.

In late October 2026 [NIRA announced that its Hubiye platform is in operation](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202611/somalia-puts-hubiye-national-id-verification-platform-into-operation>), letting service providers check an ID against its database by a one-time password sent to the holder. [UNDP Somalia reports Hubiye checks across 25 services](<https://www.undp.org/somalia/stories/driving-digital-transformation-somalia-2025-highlights>), public and private. [NIRA's eAqoonsi app carries the national ID on a phone](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202608/somalia-pushes-for-stronger-adoption-of-eaqoonsi-digital-id-app>), and by August 2026 it had passed 50,000 downloads. The latest dated fact found is the late October 2026 announcement.

[India's foreign ministry says Ooru Digital is building a MOSIP-based National Digital Identity system and a National Citizen Portal](<https://www.mea.gov.in/Portal/ForeignRelation/India-SaoTome26.pdf>). The portal was launched on 27 March 2026 and gives access to public services through a national ID login. [The World Bank mission reports working prototypes of a Verifiable Credentials Infrastructure and an electronic Signature service, with e-signature planned for May 2026](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099102025185177863/pdf/P177158-d0ebd79d-6646-4e92-b9ae-1183b632c15a.pdf>). The portal launch is the one dated change found in the last twelve months, and the login is not shown in use. No source found since October 2023 says an authentication service is in use. [In July 2024 APC said commercial banks could check the civil registry to verify identity](<https://www.apc.org/en/news/risk-human-rights-infringement-eswatini-rushes-regulate-ict-sector>), and that the national ID card did not yet meet the criteria for digital identification. In March 2025 the central bank [said financial institutions verify customers against the civil registry](<https://www.bis.org/review/r250311k.htm>). In October 2025 it [launched an e-KYC registry](<https://www.ecofinagency.com/news-digital/0110-49197-eswatini-central-bank-launches-e-kyc-platform-to-support-financial-inclusion>) that banks, financial institutions and certain public administrations can use to verify clients. [Government e-services that require SeyID need a 60% validation level](<https://seyid.gov.sc>), reached by checking the holder's NIN card or passport by video against the Civil Status System. The Agency for Social Protection's ASP Connect platform, launched internally on 15 October 2025, is [reached through the SeyID portal](<https://www.nation.sc/articles/27935/asp-launches-digital-system>), which hosts all government entities' systems. The Seychelles Licensing Authority's online services [require a SeyID account](<https://www.sla.gov.sc/online-services/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. WISeKey said in April 2024 that the SeyID app holds the National ID in an e-wallet, but no state source says the authorities accept that card. Mature would need a state-accepted mobile ID app, ID wallet or signed credentials in service.

In the last twelve months, [on 16 November 2026 the finance ministry put BIOSECU-CRT into service](<https://finances.gouv.tg/biosecu-crt-le-controle-de-vie-des-retraites-entre-dans-lere-du-numerique/>), an online face check that pensioners are alive. The 2026 playbook counts [over 450,000 Mobile IDs linked to a phone number and 35,000 linked to devices](<https://id4africa.com/2026/files/T1-3-2-Tunisia-FINAL.pdf>). Holders use them to reach online services and to sign documents and contracts in the citizen portal. In the last twelve months, in August 2026 the communication technologies ministry [launched the Khadamet app](<https://www.lapresse.tn/2026/08/31/services-administratifs-numeriques-lancement-de-lapplication-mobile-khadamet/>), which opens administrative services through the digital identity. An agriculture ministry circular of September 2026 [requires its bodies to sign users in through E-Houwiya by 15 November](<https://www.tunisie-tribune.com/2026/09/18/numerisation-le-ministere-de-lagriculture-integre-lidentite-numerique-e-houwiya-dici-novembre-2026/>). NITA-U told ID4Africa in 2025 that [UgPass has over 10 million subscribers and 35 public bodies](<https://www.id4africa.com/2025/files/PS3-5-NITA-DigitalTrust-FINAL.pdf>), and its slides show the app verifying users of e-services without passwords. In October 2026 NITA-U said UGHub [links NIRA's registry to more than 150 public bodies](<https://www.newvision.co.ug/category/news/nira-to-register-learners-correct-identity-er-NV_241639_102026>).
